name: cc-stretch
description: Stretchtext replies for Claude Code: short by default, each phrase grows in place when you click it

linkMarks.title: Closed stretch marks
linkMarks.description: Marks on a phrase you can open, as a list of bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, dim, inverse. Empty keeps the underline; none takes every mark away.

linkTextColor.title: Closed stretch text colour
linkTextColor.description: Text colour of a phrase you can open: a hex colour such as #87d7ff, or a theme colour name. Empty keeps the text's own colour.

linkHighlight.title: Closed stretch highlight
linkHighlight.description: Background of a phrase you can open, as a hex colour such as #264f78. Its text turns near black or near white, whichever reads better. Empty for none.
